mapper.sql: s.settlement_id, s.application_id, s.item_code, c.code_name AS item_name, s.expense_date, s.vendor_name, s.supply_amount, s.vat_amount, s.total_amount, s.description, s.receipt_file_id, f.original_name AS receipt_file_name, s.status, s.reject_reason, s.resubmit_count, s.reviewed_by, s.reviewed_at, s.created_at
FROM settlement s LEFT JOIN com_code_detail c ON s.item_code = c.code_id AND c.group_id = 'EXP_ITEM' LEFT JOIN com_file f ON s.receipt_file_id = f.file_id
mapper.select:
SELECT , app.receipt_no, app.project_name, u.company_name
INNER JOIN application app ON s.application_id = app.application_id INNER JOIN users u ON app.company_user_id = u.user_id
ORDER BY s.created_at ASC, s.settlement_id ASC
LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement SET status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{audit.userId}, updated_at = #{audit.now} WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'

UPDATE settlement SET item_code = #{itemCode}, expense_date = #{expenseDate}, vendor_name = #{vendorName}, supply_amount = #{supplyAmount}, vat_amount = #{vatAmount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, description = #{description}, receipt_file_id = #{receiptFileId}, status = 'REQUESTED', reject_reason = NULL, reviewed_by = NULL, reviewed_at = NULL, resubmit_count = resubmit_count + 1, updated_by = #{audit.userId}, updated_at = #{audit.now} WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'REJECTED'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM settlement WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'APPROVED'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM settlement WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'REQUESTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_history (settlement_id, action_code, total_amount, memo, actor_id, acted_at) VALUES (#{settlementId}, #{actionCode}, #{totalAmount}, #{memo}, #{audit.userId}, #{audit.now})
